subject: Film & Cinema
title: Ticking Clocks and Urgency
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ticking Clocks and Urgency.

hook.text: The bomb will explode in two hours. That single fact drives the entire film.

buildup.text: Ticking clocks create urgency by imposing a deadline on the protagonist's goal.

discovery.text: Dunkirk, Speed, and 24 all use time pressure to keep audiences gripping their seats.

twist.text: The clock doesn't need to be literal — a wedding, a trial, or sunrise all work.

climax.text: Deadlines force characters to act before they're ready, revealing who they truly are.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a ticking clock in screenwriting?
options: To show the time of day
To create urgency that forces characters to act
